featured_reviews.name: Sachin Boga
featured_reviews.review_text: Kamgar Swimming Pool is one of Mumbai’s most popular and affordable public swimming facilities, located in the central Dadar–Parel area, making it highly accessible for residents across the city. Known for its large indoor pool and well-structured setup, it caters to both beginners and experienced swimmers, offering coaching sessions as well as general swimming access at reasonable rates. The facility has undergone upgrades in recent years, with improved changing rooms, lighting, and additional sports amenities within the complex, making it more modern and user-friendly.   One of its biggest advantages is its affordability and inclusivity, as it was originally designed to support workers and the general public, yet it continues to attract a diverse crowd including fitness enthusiasts and corporate members.   The pool is spacious and suitable for training, with varying depths that accommodate different skill levels, but it can get quite crowded during peak hours, especially in the summer season. While maintenance and cleanliness are generally decent, the high footfall sometimes affects the overall experience. Despite minor drawbacks like crowding and waiting time, Kamgar Swimming Pool remains a reliable and value-for-money option for swimming in Mumbai, especially for those looking for a centrally located and budget-friendly facility.

featured_reviews.name: Gurvinder Pal Singh Kalra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Title: A Refreshing Oasis in the Heart of Mumbai

As a resident of Mahim, I've been frequenting the Mahatma Gandhi Swimming Pool for many years, and I've always been impressed by its facilities and the overall swimming experience it offers. While there's always room for improvement, I believe the pool deserves a solid 4-star rating, reflecting its strengths and acknowledging the areas where it could enhance its offerings.

Cleanliness and Maintenance:

The pool complex is generally well-maintained, with clean and hygienic pools, changing rooms, and shower areas. The staff regularly checks the water quality, ensuring it meets the necessary standards. While there have been instances of minor cleanliness issues, they've been promptly addressed by the staff.

Facilities and Amenities:

The pool complex boasts a variety of amenities catering to swimmers of all ages and skill levels. The main pool, an Olympic-sized one, is ideal for lap swimming and training. The separate diving pool is perfect for practicing dives and aquatic stunts. Additionally, there's a smaller pool for kids, providing a safe and fun environment for them to learn and enjoy the water.

Pool Staff and Safety:

The pool staff is generally helpful and attentive, ensuring the safety of swimmers at all times. Experienced lifeguards are stationed around the pools, keeping a watchful eye on everyone. The pool also has clear signage and safety guidelines in place to minimize the risk of accidents.

Overall Experience:

Mahatma Gandhi Swimming Pool is a great place to come for a refreshing swim, whether you're looking for a leisurely workout or a fun family outing. The pool's facilities are well-maintained, the staff is friendly and helpful, and the safety measures are commendable. While there's always room for improvement, the pool consistently delivers a positive swimming experience, earning it a solid 4-star rating.

Areas for Improvement:

Parking: The pool's parking facilities can be limited during peak hours, making it challenging to find a spot. Expanding the parking area or introducing valet parking services would be beneficial.

Shower Rooms: The shower rooms could be refurbished to provide a more modern and comfortable experience. Upgrading the fixtures and adding more shower cubicles would enhance the overall experience.

Food Options: While there are a few snack and beverage options available at the canteen it closes by 9 pm and expanding the food menu to include more substantial meals would cater to swimmers who spend longer hours at the pool.

Despite these areas for improvement, Mahatma Gandhi Swimming Pool remains a valuable asset to the Dadar community and a popular choice for both casual swimmers and fitness enthusiasts. Its dedication to cleanliness, safety, and providing a welcoming environment makes it a rewarding place to spend a day in the water.

The Young Men’s Christian Association (YMCA) is a well-known institution that provides a variety of professional and skill-based courses, including computer training programs. It has built a strong reputation for offering quality education at affordable fees, making it a popular choice among students and working individuals.

The computer course at YMCA is designed to cater to both beginners and advanced learners. The syllabus is well-structured and covers important topics such as basic computer operations, MS Office, internet applications, programming languages, and other relevant software. The course is regularly updated according to current industry requirements, which helps students stay competitive in the job market

Another positive aspect is the reasonable fee structure compared to other private institutes. The certification provided after course completion is valuable and recognized, which helps students in getting job opportunities.

However, there is still some scope for improvement, such as extending lab hours for extra practice and introducing more advanced and specialized courses

featured_reviews.name: Amir Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Team  - YMCA Procter Branch Mumbai,

Today was the final day of my two-month training, and I could not let it pass without thanking the entire team.
I would like to extend my heartfelt gratitude to the entire team of YMCA Procter Branch Swimming Training Branch for providing such an excellent training experience over the last two months.

A very special thanks to Amul Raj Sir, Sebastian Paul Sir ,Peter Sir, Rashid Sir, Sadique Sir, Ashim Sir, Mr. Ali, Mr. Huzefa, and also to the Office Staff, caretakers, reception(Mr. Patil & Mr. Sudhir ) & housekeeping staff.

The entire team is truly excellent in both their work and their attitude, consistently creating a positive and motivating environment for all learners.

The program has been extremely well-structured, and I truly appreciate the dedication, support, and professionalism shown by all the coaches and staff.

Each one of them has contributed immensely—not just in teaching swimming techniques but also in creating an environment where beginners like me felt comfortable, confident, and motivated.

The trainers’ patience, personal attention, and continuous encouragement helped me overcome aquaphobia and learn to swim with confidence.

As a kidney transplant recipient who is grateful to have completed a decade post-surgery today (16th August 2025), I never imagined in my dreams that I could take up swimming. Yet, this journey has shown me that with the right guidance, patience, and encouragement, even the most distant goals can become achievable.

However, the coaches handled my case with utmost care, calmly guiding me through my skill gaps, correcting me on every dive, and advising me with patience.

While I have gained significant knowledge and comfort in swimming to the best of my physical ability, I am now motivated to further enhance my skills and continue this journey with YMCA Procter branch.

I must also mention that the pool facilities are maintained exceptionally well—clean, hygienic, and welcoming round the clock—which adds to the overall positive experience.

I would be delighted to continue my swimming journey with the YMCA Procter branch and further enhance my skills, progressing at a pace that aligns with my personal fitness and well-being.

Thank you once again to the entire YMCA Procter family for your dedication and warmth. I look forward to being part of your sessions again soon.

Warm regards,
Aamir

featured_reviews.review_text:
Michael Phelps Swimming at Dadar Club is a great place for both beginners and intermediate swimmers to learn and improve their skills. The coaching follows a structured program focusing on proper techniques like balance, breathing, and body positioning, which really helps in building confidence in water.

The trainers are professional, supportive, and ensure that each student gets proper guidance. The pool is generally well-maintained, and safety is given high priority during sessions. The environment is friendly and motivating, making it comfortable even for those who are initially scared of water.

One of the best things about this academy is its systematic teaching method, inspired by international standards, which helps learners progress step by step. However, at times the batches can feel slightly crowded, and schedule management could be improved.

Overall, it’s a good investment if you’re serious about learning swimming with proper technique and discipline.

featured_reviews.name: Kapil Bhatia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Positives:

Temperature-Controlled Pool – A big advantage, especially during rains and winter.
9-Foot Depth – Ideal for learning diving and improving treading water skills.
6-Day Availability – Open six days a week, making it easy to choose batches as per convenience.
Coaches – Highly professional, patient, courteous, dedicated, and knowledgeable.
All Swimming Strokes – Comprehensive training covering freestyle, breaststroke, backstroke, and butterfly.
Patient Learning Approach – Coaches ensure everyone learns at their own pace with proper attention.
Supportive Staff – Mouzam, Sakshi, and the entire administrative team are extremely helpful and cooperative.
All Age Groups Welcome – From kids as young as 5 to adults over 75, proving age is never a barrier.

My Journey:

I already knew breaststroke, but I always wanted to learn the other swimming styles. Like many, I never really found the time or push to start. When my wife joined the Michael Phelps Swimming program at Willingdon Sports Club, I would accompany her. One day, Mouzam encouraged me to join as well.

Initially, I was unsure—did I really need to learn new strokes? But I eventually decided to take the plunge, both literally and figuratively.

Starting out wasn’t easy. Learning new strokes felt challenging, but beginner coach Mahesh Sir played a key role in helping me pick up freestyle and backstroke. As I progressed, advanced coach Prayag Sir helped refine my breaststroke—I realized how much energy I had been wasting due to incorrect technique. He also guided me through learning butterfly, which is by far the most challenging stroke. Along the way, he fine-tuned all my strokes, especially backstroke and breaststroke.

Both coaches offered exceptional guidance, focusing on technique, form correction, drills, and personalized attention.

A special mention to Sameer Sir as well—though I had limited sessions with him, his professionalism and dedication stood out.

Even with prior knowledge of basic swimming, it took me nearly a year to confidently learn all strokes. The coaches and staff are incredibly friendly and always ready to help with any concerns.

A big thank you to Mahesh Sir, Prayag Sir, and Mouzam for their consistent support and dedication.

Final Thought:
The facility and coaching are excellent—but consistency is the key to truly learning and improving in swimming.

featured_reviews.name: Charmy Mody
featured_reviews.review_text: Mumbai’s largest indoor swimming pool offers a well-designed and professionally managed environment for swimmers of all ages and skill levels. The pool is impeccably maintained with clean water. Changing rooms, showers, and common areas are hygienic, spacious, and thoughtfully designed. Safety is clearly a priority, with trained lifeguards, proper supervision, and well-maintained equipment. The staff is courteous, professional, and always ready to assist, creating a welcoming atmosphere. What truly sets this facility apart is the coaching - led by an Olympian Virdhawal Khade, whose training for competitive athletes is truly par excellence, combining technical excellence, discipline, and personalized guidance. Its convenient location, along with ample parking, adds to the overall ease and comfort of the experience. Highly recommended for both recreational swimmers and serious competitors.

featured_reviews.name: tej mody
featured_reviews.review_text:
This Olympic-size indoor swimming pool is an excellent facility for swimmers of all levels. Centrally located with great road and rail connectivity, it is easy to access. The pool, changing rooms, and overall infrastructure are very well maintained, with high standards of hygiene and friendly, helpful staff.

What truly sets this place apart is the coaching. Coach Virdhawal Khade and his team bring exceptional experience, discipline, and passion to every session. The training is structured, motivating, and tailored to each swimmer, helping them build strong technique and confidence. Learning from an Olympian is truly inspiring.

Overall, it’s a perfect blend of world-class infrastructure and outstanding coaching. Highly recommended for swimming, fitness, and competitive training.
